editorial.blurb: Lao Peng You serves bold, handmade Chinese comfort food that lingers in memory—Dan Dan noodles with savory depth, tender dumplings, and standout lamb and cumin bread in a lively, welcoming space.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive before 5:30pm on weekdays to avoid long waits, or come around 4pm on weekends; the cold noodles with beef and pork chive dumplings are highly recommended and worth the trip.
